result.title: The Future Is Finer: Multivariate Time Series Super-Resolution Forecasting
result.summary: Web platforms run on multivariate time series, from service telemetry and Web traffic logs to sensor streams served through Web APIs. Yet, retention policies often archive them at coarse granularity to save storage and bandwidth. Decisions such as autoscaling, alerting, and billing operate at finer granularity than existing forecasters reach, since these models predict at the resolution of their input. We therefore introduce Multivariate Time Series Super-Resolution Forecasting (MTS-SRF), which forecasts fine-grained futures from coarse histories, and propose TimeMagnifier to address its three challenges. Fourier Anchor counters data sparsity by fitting each input window to a trend-Fourier structure with sparse cross-variable gating; De-noise Only constrains fine-grained ambiguity by refining along the resolution axis rather than the noise axis, lengthening the grid level by level; and banded DTW Alignment corrects cross-resolution misalignment against the coarse forecast. On the first MTS-SRF benchmark, with ten datasets from five domains, real archived cross-resolution pairs, strengthened baseline adaptations, and five-seed significance tests, TimeMagnifier is best on every dataset, resolution coefficient, and metric against 15 baselines and cuts MSE by 12.3% on average. Its De-noise Only and DTW stages also transfer as a plug-in that lowers the MSE of existing forecasters by 5.1% to 9.0%. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出多变量时间序列超分辨率预测任务，即由粗粒度历史预测细粒度未来，并提出 TimeMagnifier：用趋势-Fourier 锚定缓解稀疏性，沿分辨率轴逐级而非沿噪声轴细化以约束细节歧义，并用 banded DTW 对齐跨分辨率偏差。
AI.relevance_reason: 沿分辨率轴逐级加长网格的渐进细化与跨分辨率对齐，可能为 LVR 中 coarse-to-fine latent 状态更新及跨尺度状态对齐提供可供核查的类比线索，但与视觉/多模态推理本身无直接联系。
